description.en: Copies a folder to another place (another disk, a USB drive, a cloud folder) with robocopy. Only new and changed files are copied. Mirror = true also removes files from the copy that are gone from the original; it is refused when the Destination already holds files that this backup did not make.
description.ru: Копирует папку в другое место (другой диск, флешку, облачную папку) через robocopy. Копируются только новые и изменённые файлы. Mirror = true также удаляет из копии файлы, которых больше нет в оригинале; не выполняется, если в папке назначения уже есть файлы, сделанные не этой копией.

description.en: Where the copy goes (created if missing)
Also remove files from the copy that were deleted in the original
description.ru: Удалять из копии файлы, удалённые в оригинале

script: # Mirror deletes for good whatever the copy has and the original has not: only into an empty / new folder or one this backup made.
# A freshly formatted drive root holds only these system folders: they don't count, and robocopy leaves them alone.

if ($P.Mirror -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $P.Destination) -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $mark) -and @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $P.Destination -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -notin $sys } | Select-Object -First 1).Count) { Write-Output 'Mirror refused: the Destination folder already holds files that this backup did not make, and Mirror would delete them for good. Choose an empty or new Destination folder, or run without Mirror.'; exit 4 }
# Marked BEFORE the copy: a run that fails half-way (robocopy code 8+) still leaves a folder this backup made.

if ($P.Mirror -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $mark)) { try { [void][IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($P.Destination); [IO.File]::WriteAllText($mark, 'Made by a mirror backup. Delete this file to stop mirroring into this folder.') } catch { Write-Output ('note: ' + $_.Exception.Message) } }
if ($code -ge 8) { Write-Output ("Backup failed: robocopy exit code " + $code); exit $code }
